title: WolOS release metrics
description: What one release run measured (tests/metrics.sh RUN_DIR). Frozen keys: boot_s, install_s, pages, idle_cpu_ms_s, shell_map_ms. A number is null when the run did not measure it; it is never estimated. Every non-null number has an evidence row naming the file it was read from and the command that produced that file. The webapps block belongs to the web-app benchmark (WA-1) and is null until that bench fills it.

date.description: Day of the first journey (UTC on the forge).

version.description: VERSION_ID of the image, or the ISO's json.

boot_s.description: Seconds from VM start to the live image's first screen (journey live-boot, through its first wait-text).

boot_systemd_s.description: systemd's own 'Startup finished ... = N s' of the same boot (kernel + userspace, no firmware).

install_s.description: Seconds from 'wolos-install: prepare' to 'wolos-install: done' on the installer's console (journey install-auto).

pages.description: Installer pages a person sees on the default path: 'shot page-*' steps of journey install-gui.

idle_cpu_ms_s.description: CPU ms per second of the compositor plus wol-shell at rest: idle.txt (design/tools/perf/idle.py output) of any journey.

shell_map_ms.description: wol-shell start to its first window mapped: 'wol-shell: first map' (WOL_SHELL_TIMING) in a journey's logs.

vms.description: The VM configurations the journeys ran in (wolvm vm.json).

from.description: File in the run directory the number was read from.

command.description: The command that produced that file.

webapps.description: Reserved for WA-1 (web-app benchmark): per-app PSS/RSS, cold start, frame times, idle wakeups, runtime bundled|wolos.
